|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Phasma (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma-2022-06-01.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-captainphasma-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-D-captainphasma-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-captainphasma-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Phasma]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-captainphasma022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Charming To The Last”. Text: “Adds one battle destiny with a stormtrooper. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-captainphasmae8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Phasma (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2025<ref name="img-captainphasma5637ac6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e commit 5637ac6] (12 December 2025); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the First Order icon at top left was redrawn and the picture re-rendered (small differences, visible when zoomed); words, mark and margin are unchanged; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image.
